description: This file defines the ValidatorFactory class, which creates validation closures using Symfony's Validator component. It provides methods to generate callables for validating individual values or iterables with specific constraints.

classes.name: ValidatorFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create validation closures configured with specific constraints, utilizing Symfony's Validator component.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects a ValidatorInterface instance for performing validations.

methods.name: createClosure
methods.description: Creates a closure that validates a single value against specified constraints, optionally allowing nulls.

methods.name: createClosureForIterator
methods.description: Creates a closure that validates each element in an iterable or array against specified constraints, optionally allowing nulls.
